syllabus_topics: Programming with processes, tasks, and files
Organization and evolution of operating systems
The kernel of a multiprogrammed system
Virtual memory and operating system memory management algorithms
assessment_rules: The continuous assessment project consists of 2 mandatory exercises in groups of 2 students, with a minimum grade of 9.0. The project grade is calculated as AvGrupo x AvInd, where AvGrupo is 50% for P1 and 50% for P2, and AvInd is an individual assessment. For the normal season, the final grade is 50% project and 50% normal season exam, with a minimum exam grade of 8.0. For the resit season, a new exam can replace the normal season exam grade if it improves it. For Special Season, assessment is 40% practical component (project or special practical exercise) and 60% theoretical exam, with minimum grades of 9.0 for practical and 8.0 for theoretical.
bibliography: José Alves Marques, Paulo Ferreira, Carlos Ribeiro, Luís Veiga, Rodrigo Rodrigues, Sistemas Operativos (2ª Edição), FCA, 2012 (main)
Andrew S. Tanenbaum, Modern Operating Systems, 4th Edition, Pearson, 2015 (main)
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LEIC-A Eng. Informática e de Computadores (IST)
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Informática e de Computadores - Alameda (LEIC-A)
